model.name: server.attachChainMethod
model.description: R31.10 fix (server.ts:1644-1646): in the /api/trace/children resolver, attach entry.chainMethod = the UC's authoritative model.method whenever type==='UseCase' && ct==='Class' && ucMethodIor - in ALL modes (dropped the queryMode==='trace'-only gate). So the client rb-trace-tree resolves each UC to its correct method in EVERY view (trace + scenario/non-trace), never a Class.methods[] sibling; the fallback fires ONLY when UC.method is genuinely empty (a real incomplete chain, correctly surfaced). Architect design design-r31.10-chain-resolve-all-modes.md.
